title: V5 Epic 4 E-4-2a multi-tenant boundary contract evidence
description: Strict (additionalProperties:false + unevaluatedProperties:false) evidence artifact for V5 Epic 4 slice E-4-2a (Multi-tenant advisory boundary contract; early seal). Captures decision, write-set, invariant audit, guard-flag pin (3 const false), advisory-only marker (matrix advisory), and cross-AI provider distinctness. Bound to .claude/plans/E-4-2a-MULTI-TENANT-BOUNDARY-CONTRACT.md + tests/test_epic_4_2a_multi_tenant_boundary.py + .claude/plans/tenant_isolation_matrix.v1.json (placeholder state).

write_set.description: Sorted list of files MODIFIED or ADDED on the slice branch relative to origin/main; MUST exactly equal `git diff --name-only origin/main..HEAD` (sorted).

guard_flags.description: All three runtime guard flags MUST stay const false in this slice. Key-string absence in the contract artifacts is re-verified by test (advisory_dil_test + no_guard_flip).

matrix_advisory.description: Pinned mirror of the matrix advisory contract: all 7 dimensions present in placeholder state; no live validation; no runtime enforcement claim. E-4-2b will promote matrix_status to 'e_4_2b_final_seal' and entries to 'filled'.

reviewer_providers.description: Cross-AI provider list (implementer + reviewer). Provider strings MUST be distinct (HARD RULE Cross-AI Peer Review: provider-level distinct). E-4-2a uses 2-way (Claude/anthropic + Codex/openai); E-4-2b uses 3-way (adds Mavis/minimax).

no_workflow_mutation.description: Pinned true: this slice MUST NOT touch .github/workflows/**. Test enforces via git diff allowlist.

no_pyproject_change.description: Pinned true: this slice MUST NOT modify pyproject.toml (Epic 4 invariant).

no_runtime_module_change.description: Pinned true: this slice only ADDS new schema files under ao_kernel/defaults/schemas/; it MUST NOT modify existing ao_kernel/* module files (ao_kernel/__init__.py and other modules untouched).

cross_ai_review_thread.description: Optional Codex MCP thread id for post-impl review (filled in after review submission).
